assays.assay_description: Operant chambers (Med Associates, 56×56×40.5 cm) with two retractable levers; rats discriminated short (3 s) vs. long (12 s) house-light stimuli and intermediate durations (4-11 s). Measures: T50, slope, difference limen, Weber fraction, response latency, reward latency, correct/incorrect/omission responses.

application_type.evidence: All compounds were given intraperitoneally (IP) 20 min before the test session

time_to_assay.evidence: All compounds were given intraperitoneally (IP) 20 min before the test session

outcomes.summary: (S)-Ketamine (15 mg/kg) right-shifted the psychometric curve indicating time underestimation but reduced accuracy and increased latencies. (R)-Ketamine had no timing effect but reduced incorrect responses at 7.5 mg/kg. Psilocybin and psilocin did not alter timing measures (T50, slope, difference limen, Weber fraction) but at the highest doses increased response/reward latencies, increased omissions, and reduced correct responses. Norpsilocin had no measurable effects.
outcomes.evidence: (S)-Ketamine at the dose of 15 mg/kg shifted the psychometric curve to the right ... Psilocybin affected neither T50, slope function, difference limen, nor Weber fraction ... Norpsilocin affected neither T50, slope function, difference limen, nor Weber fraction

assays.assay_description: Operant boxes with 5 LED-illuminated nose-poke holes; rats responded to brief stimuli for food reward. Tested in 3 variants: standard (Sd=1 s), easier (Sd=2 s), and variable ITI (2.5, 5, 7.5, 10 s). Measures: accuracy, omissions, premature responses, perseverative responses, timeout responses, correct/incorrect response latencies, reward latency.

application_type.evidence: All compounds were given intraperitoneally (IP) 20 min before the test session

setup_habituation.evidence: Animals were trained in changing conditions ... qualified for the test after reaching ... criteria

setup_restrain.evidence: Rats performed the task freely in the operant chambers

food_restriction.evidence: mild food restriction (~17-20 g of food per day) ... maintained at 85% of their free-feeding weight throughout the study

time_to_assay.evidence: All compounds were given intraperitoneally (IP) 20 min before the test session

sample_size.evidence: 40 (5-CSRTT) ... male Sprague-Dawley rats; Table 2 shows e.g. veh (12); 0.3 (13); 1 (8)

outcomes.summary: (S)-Ketamine (15 mg/kg) decreased accuracy, increased omissions and timeout responses, and reduced premature responses at long ITI (consistent with time underestimation). (R)-Ketamine at 30 mg/kg increased accuracy in vITI. Psilocybin and psilocin at the highest doses decreased correct responses, increased omissions, prolonged correct/incorrect/reward latencies; psilocin (0.72 mg/kg) reduced premature and perseverative responses. Norpsilocin produced no effects.
outcomes.statistics: (R)-ketamine accuracy in vITI: dose F(3,292)=8.125, p<0.001. (S)-ketamine accuracy: F(3,279)=5.931, p<0.001; omissions F(3,284)=23.181, p<0.001; premature × ITI interaction F(9,284)=4.292, p<0.001.

judge_notes: Two assays retained: TDT and 5-CSRTT. 5-CSRTT variants (Sd=1s, Sd=2s, vITI) were collapsed into one assay per rubric rule (same paradigm with different stimulus parameters).
Included (R)- and (S)-ketamine in dosing block alongside psilocybin/psilocin/norpsilocin since they are administered psychedelic-like comparator compounds central to this study.
food_restriction scored 'before' for both assays (chronic 85% body-weight restriction throughout study), overriding candidates that scored 'no'.
E8 scored Yes for both assays (food pellets delivered during the session as operant reward).
D3 scored 15+ for both assays based on Tables 1-2 listing 18-22 weeks of testing with 1-2 sessions per week per assay.
TDT D2 left at <15 min with low confidence: paper specifies 20-min habituation/training sessions but does not explicitly state test session duration; conservative score with low confidence.
